CVE-2026-105958.title: A flaw was found in spice-server. Multiple migration data handler ...
CVE-2026-105958.description: A flaw was found in spice-server. Multiple migration data handlers use client-supplied offsets from SPICE_MSGC_MIGRATE_DATA messages without bounds validation, allowing a malicious authenticated SPICE client during VM live migration to read arbitrary heap memory or trigger heap corruption via out-of-bounds read and write operations on the message buffer.

CVE-2026-105959.title: A flaw was found in spice-server. The GLZ encoder dictionary rest ...
CVE-2026-105959.description: A flaw was found in spice-server. The GLZ encoder dictionary restore path truncates a size_t allocation size to int when calling the malloc callback, allowing a malicious authenticated SPICE client during VM live migration to trigger a massive heap buffer overflow by sending a crafted max_encoders value in migration data.
